titel: Graustark, by George Barr McCutcheon. Part VII.

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Princess Yetive faces the forced partition of her kingdom and a desperate race to save…
kurzfassung: As the treaty to divide Graustark approaches signing, Princess Yetive discovers Lorry is missing and assumes he has fled to safety. During the ceremony, she pleads for leniency before being forced to sign away half her realm. Just then, Lorry and Captain Quinnox appear, leading to a dramatic accusation and a stunning confession.
stichpunkte: Crowds mass outside the castle as Edelweiss awaits the signing of the decree dividing Graustark.
Princess Yetive discovers Captain Quinnox missing and assumes Lorry has successfully escaped.
During the throne room ceremony, Yetive's plea for a time extension is coldly rejected by Prince Balarus.
Just as Yetive touches the pen to the decree, Gabriel of Dalsbergen interrupts, accusing her of hiding the fugitive.
Captain Quinnox and a haggard Lorry suddenly appear in the throne room, shocking the assembly.
Yetive declares her love for Lorry before the entire court, risking her crown to defend him.
Harry Anguish reveals that his accusation against Gabriel was based entirely on a bluff and guesswork.
Gabriel's accomplice Berowag breaks under the pressure, exposing Gabriel as the true murderer of Prince Lorenz.
Prince Balarus relents, offering a ten-year extension and offering his friendship to Graustark.
Princess Yetive convenes her ministers to challenge royal tradition and demand acceptance of her marriage to an American.

clips.text: Harry Anguish teases the young countess with cryptic hints about a joyful surprise.

Princess Yetive publicly defies the entire court and her political advisors by confessing her affection for the accused man.

clips.hook: Oh, I just guessed at it
clips.text: Harry Anguish casually admits to the Chief of Police that his grand accusation was completely fabricated.

clips.hook: I am so sorry for Queens!
clips.text: Looking out across the plains, Yetive reflects on her journey with a witty parting remark.

beschreibung:
The Graustark novels are stories of court intrigue, royal disguise, and romance similar to Anthony Hope's 1894 novel, The Prisoner of Zenda, and its sequels. They were popular best-sellers at the time they were published and the original editions are still readily available in used book shops. The novels gave their name to a fictional genre called Graustarkian: this genre contains tales of romance and intrigue usually featuring titled characters in small, fictional, Central European countries.
During the 1870's, Graustark's ruler, Prince Ganlook, was killed in a war with neighboring Axphain. As part of the ensuing peace treaty, Graustark agreed to pay a large indemnity to Axphain, to be due, with interest, in fifteen years. (From Wikipedia.)
